findings.impact: Revenue and units overstatement if counted
findings.recommended_policy: Drop excess exact duplicates and retain an exception table

findings.impact: Cannot attribute experimental drink, combo, or empty-cup records to a core SKU
findings.recommended_policy: Exclude from core menu analysis and report their unit/revenue bridge

findings.impact: 75 retained sales rows have no exact-week fruit cost
findings.recommended_policy: Use explicit first-available-week proxy with sensitivity and status flag

findings.impact: 4 rows / 96 cups can understate waste cost if sum skips nulls
findings.recommended_policy: Estimate fruit plus packaging under the same proxy policy and disclose

findings.impact: A budget variance can be mislabelled
findings.recommended_policy: Show product margin and contribution layers separately; confirm boundary with management
